sections.title: Employment Contract
sections.text:
Frost, a member of Team Rainbow, has already deployed her Welcome Mats.

This congenial hunter always has things planned out even for the most haphazard of guests.

sections.title: Profile
sections.text:
One of the members of Team Rainbow, Frost is a firm, focused and energetic individual adept at combat in outdoor environments.
She mainly uses modified mechanical traps named 'Welcome Mats.' Through strategic placement, they can obstruct the enemy and provide tactical support to the entire team.

sections.title: Clinical Analysis
sections.text:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Frost shows no sign of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] Undisclosed
Relevant data will not be disclosed due to the Medical Department's agreement.

sections.title: Archive File 1
sections.text:
Operator Tina, codename Frost. A member of Rainbow Six, and one of the witnesses to the 'Watchtower 33' incident, Frost registered with Rhodes Island as a cooperative party following the incident.
The members of Team Rainbow are mostly reluctant to reveal their past, which we will not object to given that our partners have the right to secrecy regarding their internal information.
As with the other members of Team Rainbow, operator Frost has extremely comprehensive combat experience, far surpassing the average operator in various fields including teamwork. Based on the report submitted to the HR department, operator Frost seems to have participated in numerous outdoor rescue missions and is a talented wilderness survival specialist.
However, please note that the members of Team Rainbow are only working with us on a temporary basis and are not formal employees of Rhodes Island. They still have many things they are busy with, so please do not rely overly much on their strength.

sections.title: Archive File 2
sections.text: Without a doubt, Frost is an experienced hunter, yet she is even more than that. During her stay at Rhodes Island, Frost spent most of her time hunkered down in one of Rhodes Island's workshops, producing a full set of hunting equipment and six or seven models of hunting traps. She has a never-ending list of topics to discuss regarding hunting, and can often be found exchanging hunting experiences with operators from Sami and Kazimierz.

sections.title: Archive File 3
sections.text:
Be it stealth, tracking, or hunting... Operator Frost already exhibits excellent potential even without the use of Originium Arts. Combined with her extensive use of traps, this unique form of combat is very suited for operating on Terra's wastelands.
Incidentally, Miss Frost's cooking skills are not bad. I believe that even if she is lacking supplies, Miss Frost will still be able to find a way to survive in the wasteland.
Recently, she has been doing a detailed study on 'Rhodes Island Wilderness Survival Guide.' I'm not sure if the information in that book will be of use to her.

sections.title: Archive File 4
sections.text:
[Classified Log]
After much deliberation, I've decided to record the following as an archived record, since the notes and investigations here are born out of my own personal interest, even though I believe they are very much necessary.
The four operators of Team Rainbow are far more peculiar than we think, and many people are unaware that their living environment may in fact be vastly different from our own.
Though they are by definition armed personnel, each of them has received comprehensive higher education. I am astonished by the professionalism of Operator Blitz's linguistic knowledge, whereas operator Ash is skilled enough to converse fluently in two to three different languages with other people. I don't believe I need to mention the multitude of professional knowledge possessed by the other members of Team Rainbow.
They are not Infected, and have no prejudice against them. They were easily able to accept the idea of Rhodes Island extending help towards the Infected, and clearly expressed their sympathy towards them.
It's difficult to imagine what kind of country they came from.

sections.title: Promotion Record
sections.text:
[Project and Equipment Transfer Log]
Within this period, operator Frost has produced a large number of equipment by herself, including various large hunting traps, some simple snares and several hunting knives.

She has also applied for the allocation of some Originium explosives. We have assessed operator Frost's knowledge on the relevant fields, and believe that she will be able to utilize these resources properly.
